3652-5006-7272-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-5006-7272-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
3652-5006-7272-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Ornithopter, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

requires.n: Zombie Creature castable for one colored mana

728-1303-2464-3249--206.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1303-2464-3249--206.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-1303-2464-3249--206.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the zombie castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the zombie castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that zombie spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that zombie or when it enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3257-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3257-4231-7810.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

765-1479-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2557-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2557-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

567-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1308-2457-4289-4742.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7153.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

372-4681-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

413-862-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Crimson Kobolds enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2541-5796-6824.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
2541-5796-6824.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2541-4703-6824.notablePrerequisites:
Brallin has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-4703-6824.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Brallin triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3489.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a creature card in hand.
1636-3489.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{B}.
1636-3489.description:
Declare any other creature as an attacker.
When that creature isn't blocked, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{B}.
Activate a creature card's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning the unblocked attacker to your hand, putting the creature card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1150-2018.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Melira's Keepers.
When Melira's Keepers dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Melira's Keepers from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Melira's Keepers' ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3765-4668-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-4668-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-4668-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

618-4050-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.
618-4050-5887.notes: Once you have enough mana, you may instead sacrifice the Werefox Bodyguard tokens to their own abilities.

478-2821-3664-3918-5233.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-2821-3664-3918-5233.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Boros Garrison.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3582-3987-5147.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

1247-3586-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Pili-Pala exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Magus Lucea Kane has at least one +1/+1 counter on it, and does not have summoning sickness.
1247-3586-4613.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and copying the next spell you cast or ability you activate with {X} in its mana cost.
Activate Magus Lucea Kane using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1365-3723-5112-5284-5295.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3723-5112-5284-5295.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Carnifex Demon's ability by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
Repeat.

3985-4050-4343.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional untapped creature.
3985-4050-4343.description:
Activate Opposition by tapping an untapped creature you control, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tapped in step 1, adding {1}.
Resolve the Hylda of the Icy Crown trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 4/4 Elemental creature token.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

771-1378-3277-4886.notablePrerequisites:
Wildfire Eternal does not have summoning sickness.
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Izzet Chronarch.
An opponent cannot block Wildfire Eternal.
771-1378-3277-4886.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mirage Phalanx and Izzet Chronarch each trigger, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch and Mirage Phalanx with haste and without soulbond.
When the token Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Savage Beating to your hand from your graveyard.
Declare Wildfire Eternal as an attacker.
When Wildfire Eternal is not blocked, it triggers, casting Savage Beating from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, the Mirage Phalanx and Izzet Chronarch tokens trigger, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2730-4050-4668.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {B}.
When Heliod dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Heliod.
Repeat.

628-2034-3537-4417.notablePrerequisites: Hex Parasite does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-3537-4417.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hex Parasite, adding {C}{C}.
Hex Parasite dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B}, removing the +1/+1 counter from it and giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

651-1501-4046.description:
Pay {0} to activate Outrider en-Kor, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 untill end of turn.
Repeat steps 1-2 untill Task Force has infinite toughness.
Cast Predator's Rapport targeting Task Force, gaining life equal to its toughness.

893-4050-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.
